scenicChapters.title: German Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 34 km this is German Alpine Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Romantische Strasse
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 1 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
